title: Exemption; vicarious liability.
bodyText: Consistent with title 49 United States Code section 30106, a peer-to-peer car-sharing program and shared car owner shall be exempt from vicarious liability under any state or local law that imposes liability solely based upon motor vehicle ownership.
bodyHtml: [§279L-4]  Exemption; vicarious liability.  Consistent with title 49 United States Code section 30106, a peer-to-peer car-sharing program and shared car owner shall be exempt from vicarious liability under any state or local law that imposes liability solely based upon motor vehicle ownership. [L 2022, c 77, pt of §1]
